2.
Heard learned counsel for the Parties.

3. This Writ Petition has been filed by the Petitioner for a direction to the Opposite Parties to disburse the adequate compensation to the Petitioner for acquiring his land by Plot No.763/1253 of Mouza-Jolko, Tahasil, Kesinga in the district of Kalahandi.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner placed the Notice dated 11.12.2024 under Annexure-1, in which the Tahasildar-cum-Land Acquisition Officer-cum- Opposite Party No.-3 has determined the compensation amount to be Rs.2,37,620/- (Rupees Two Lakh Thirty- Seven Thousand Six Hundred Twenty only) and directed the Petitioner to appear on 16.12.2024 to receive said amount with documentary proof.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner further submitted that since the compensation has been determined at a lower amount, the Petitioner has not received the same.

Section 3G (5) and (6) of the National Highways Act,
1956 reads as follows:-
"(5)If the amount determined by the competent authority under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) is not acceptable to either of the parties, the amount shall, on an application by either of the parties, be determined by the arbitrator to be appointed by the Central Government.
( 6)Subject
to the provisions of this Act

, the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (26 of 1996) shall apply to every arbitration under this Act."
5.
In view of such provision, learned counsel for the Petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the Writ Petition to approach the appropriate authority for enhancement of the compensation amount.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of as withdrawn.
(S. K. Sahoo) Judge (Chittaranjan Dash) Judge AKPradhan Signed by: ANANTA KUMAR PRADHAN
